pages.title: What it is
pages.text: The Beishan Coin is the core currency of this mod - and a coin you can literally launch at things.$(br2)It doubles as a weapon, a tip and a key to several systems.

pages.title: Right click
pages.text: $(li)Players: tip them (Goad + Boss)$(li)Monsters: 50% Stun / 50% infighting$(li)Villagers: permanent 20% off$(li)Hold right click 3s: spawn a Team Circle$(br2)Throw with $(thing)Q$() or $(thing)V$(); sneak + Q builds the whole $(thing)test setup$() (floor under your feet + a dummy) for one coin.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Like + Coin Toss + Favorite (shapeless) = Beishan Coin (stacks to 64).$(br2)Dev Beishan Coin = Beishan Coin + Nether Star - see the Throwing chapter.
